name: Ngifuna Wena Dance
blurb: Pick a Skin to Skin dance clip, add one photo, and you do the whole amapiano routine.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Track the exact camera movement, framing, facial expressions, and body movements from the video. Keep the face, hairstyle, body, clothing, and overall appearance exactly the same as in the reference image, with no changes or distortion. Use the video's background and environment. Keep every dance move from the video in time with the beat, from the first step to the final pose. Output in 9:16 vertical format.
